title: fix(clickhouse): respect user-provided insert_quorum in cluster mode

files.patch:
@@ -2424,7 +2424,7 @@ def _static_connection_kwargs(self) -> t.Dict[str, t.Any]:
         # https://clickhouse.com/docs/en/operations/settings/settings

         # - https://github.com/ClickHouse/dbt-clickhouse/blob/44d26308ea6a3c8ead25c280164aa88191f05f47/dbt/adapters/clickhouse/dbclient.py#L77

@@ -2438,7 +2438,8 @@ def _static_connection_kwargs(self) -> t.Dict[str, t.Any]:
             #   - "INSERT succeeds only when ClickHouse manages to correctly write data to the insert_quorum of replicas during
             #       the insert_quorum_timeout"

-            settings["insert_quorum"] = "auto"
+            #   - a value set by the user in connection_settings takes precedence

@@ -1288,6 +1288,33 @@ def test_clickhouse(make_config):
     assert not config3._static_connection_kwargs["compress"]
 
 
+def test_clickhouse_insert_quorum_user_setting(make_config):
+    user_settings = {"insert_quorum": "0"}
+    config = make_config(
+        type="clickhouse",
+        host="localhost",
+        username="default",
+        password="default",
+        cluster="default",
+        connection_settings=user_settings,
+    )
+
+    # A user-provided insert_quorum is respected in cluster mode
+    assert config._static_connection_kwargs["insert_quorum"] == "0"
+    # Building the connection kwargs does not write SQLMesh's settings back into the config
+    assert config.connection_settings == {"insert_quorum": "0"}
+
+    # Without a user value, cluster mode still defaults to "auto"
+    config_default = make_config(
+        type="clickhouse",
+        host="localhost",
+        username="default",
+        password="default",
+        cluster="default",
+    )
+    assert config_default._static_connection_kwargs["insert_quorum"] == "auto"
+
+
 def test_athena(make_config):
